intro: Choosing the right area matters more than the hotel itself in Rayong. Here are the main neighborhoods, who each suits, and where to book for your travel style.

blocks.html: Short answer: For a Rayong beach trip, most people stay at Ban Phe (the pier to Koh Samet) or cross to Koh Samet itself for white-sand beaches and clear water. For a long beach near town choose Mae Ramphueng; for a quiet, family beach pick Mae Phim to the east; Rayong city suits convenience and budget.

faq.q: Where to stay for Koh Samet?
faq.a: Staying on Koh Samet itself is best if you want the beaches morning and evening — pick Sai Kaew for convenience and buzz, or a quieter southern beach. If you prefer not to stay on the island, base at Ban Phe and day-trip across by ferry.

faq.q: Is Rayong a good trip from Bangkok?
faq.a: Very much — Rayong and Koh Samet are among the closest beaches to Bangkok, about a 3-hour drive to Ban Phe then a 30–40 minute ferry to Koh Samet. Great for a weekend escape.

faq.q: Mae Phim vs Koh Samet — what is the difference?
faq.a: Koh Samet is an island reached by ferry, with white sand, clear water and more buzz, while Mae Phim is on the mainland (drive straight there), quieter and good for families who would rather skip the boat.
